conviction_note: A pre-readout Alzheimer's biotech whose Q3 P&L does not matter. The one line that could move it, ALTITUDE-AD timing, has been guided 'late 2026' at every document through 2026-10-22, and ClinicalTrials.gov puts primary completion in October 2026. So the release most likely confirms that the last 18-month visit is done or narrows the window. That is a small positive, set against a 20% five-day run-up into a print that probably carries no data, and a cash walk that leaves about $66-72m and a going-concern flag. The tail case is topline data inside the release; I put it near 5% and it has no sign I can call. abs_move 5.0 (median reaction 3.0, max 11.3, 80% realised vol, timing news possible), p_up 48. The findings sum to -0.7, the scaled number is -0.2. Both are near zero, and the gap between them is the topline tail I left unsigned.
bar: EPS consensus about -$0.39 (Benzinga, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/ABOS/earnings-forecasts, one source, unverified date), so the bar is single-sourced and every size is capped small. The line this name trades on is not EPS. It is ALTITUDE-AD topline timing, guided 'late 2026' (Q2 release 2026-08-12, investor day slides 2026-09-16, CTAD release 2026-10-22), and cash runway, guided 'into early 2027' (Q2 10-Q).
positioning_check: Short interest 2.8M shares, days to cover 2.6, FINRA settlement 2026-06-30 (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/abos/). An earlier figure is 1.68M, DTC 5.17, at 2026-04-30 (https://equibles.com/stocks/abos/shortinterest). Float is about 66.9M (stocktitan), so short interest is roughly 4% of float and not crowded. Borrow fee is about 0.3%. There is no usable option chain (ATM legs not two-sided), so no skew. Put/call OI ratio 0.24 on 149 contracts total, which says nothing. Tape: +20.1% over 5 days, -9.4% over 20 days, -39.8% from the 52-week high.

findings.finding: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06335173 (ALTITUDE-AD, 542 enrolled, active not recruiting) lists primary completion October 2026. The company moved Q3 reporting up to 2026-10-26, against 2025-11-12 last year, and on the Q2 call said it plans to go quiet before the readout. So this release is the natural place to confirm that the last participant's 18-month visit is complete, or to narrow 'late 2026' to a month. The market's expectation is the unchanged 'late 2026' wording repeated as recently as 2026-10-22. Confirmation is a mild de-risking of timing, and a slip into 2027 would be a sharp negative, given runway 'into early 2027'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prior prints were all reaffirmations of trial timing: -3.5 (2026-05-12), +1.6 (2026-08-12), -3.0 (2026-03-26), -11.3 (2025-08-12, when the topline was pushed from early to late 2026 per aggregator summaries). On a reaffirmation the name has mostly drifted lower; a slip cost double digits.
findings.why_not_priced: The 'late 2026' guide is fully priced. The narrower point is whether an LPLV or month is given on Monday. The early report date (announced 2026-10-19) and the +20% five-day run-up suggest some traders are already positioning for a timing statement, so part of this is priced. If it were fully priced, the run-up would have to be read as anticipation of data, and the release is unlikely to carry data because database lock follows the last visit by weeks.
findings.independence: Separate documents: the Q2 call summary (go quiet before readout; https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/acumen-pharmaceuticals-inc-abos-q2-230426972.html), the Oct 19 date notice (https://www.biopharmawatch.com/news/ABOS/acumen-pharmaceuticals-third-quarter-results-october-2026) and the CTAD release of 2026-10-22, which announces only baseline-characteristics posters for Nov 16-17 and repeats 'late 2026' (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/ABOS/acumen-pharmaceuticals-to-present-preliminary-baseline-hp5vi1e4200r.html).

findings.finding: The Q2 10-Q puts cash at $110.2m on 2026-06-30. After that date the company paid JCR $9.25m (July 2026), and amortization began on the $31.6m term loan: $10.1m of principal is scheduled for 2026, monthly from July, so about $5m in Q3. The Q2 operating loss was $32.6m. That puts Q3-end cash at roughly $66-72m. The company has disclosed no ATM sales in 2026 ($50m ATM available), carries going-concern language, and has runway 'into early 2027', which would end about a quarter after a late-2026 readout. The expectation is that the runway is reaffirmed. A shortened runway, or ATM use at about $2, would be the negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Going-concern language first appeared in the 2026-03-26 10-K and the stock moved -3.0. The Q1 print (-3.5) and Q2 print (+1.6) carried the same flag. The market has looked through it so far.
findings.why_not_priced: The pieces are in the 10-Q, so most of this is priced. What is not is the Q3-end number and whether the company keeps 'into early 2027' with about $70m against about $35m of quarterly outflow. A market that had priced a shortfall would trade below the roughly $70m cash level, and at about $147m market cap it does not.
findings.independence: The same document is the source of all the inputs. The panabee summary of the going-concern flag (https://www.panabee.com/news/acumen-pharmaceuticals-earnings-q2-2026-report) restates it and is not independent.

findings.finding: ABOS rose 20.1% in the five sessions to 2026-10-23 ($1.69 on 2026-10-16 per Syfe, $2.03 sealed spot). The only company news in that span is the 2026-10-19 date notice and the 2026-10-22 CTAD poster release, neither carrying data. That looks like event-anticipation buying, and a release that only reaffirms 'late 2026' may let it fade.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no comparable pre-print run-up in the baseline. 5 of 7 prior prints closed down or flat.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a positioning read, not an unpriced fact. The run-up itself is the price. The finding is that it rests on no document, so a data-free release gives it nothing to hold on to.
findings.independence: Proxy and inference only. The baseline's run_up_5d_pct of +20.12 is the same fact.

outside_window.finding: ALTITUDE-AD topline results (efficacy on iADRS at 18 months, two doses against placebo, n=542), guided 'late 2026'. This is the binary event for the stock and is most likely dated after the window (database lock follows an October 2026 primary completion). CTAD posters on Nov 16-17 are baseline data only.

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR submissions since 2026-08-01: only the 8-K of 2026-09-16 (investor day slides, 'late 2026' repeated, no database-lock date), the S-8 and the 10-Q and 8-K of 2026-08-12. No S-3, no 424B, no 8-K financing.
EDGAR full-text 'at-the-market' 2026: only the 10-K, the 10-Qs and the ARS. The Q2 10-Q says no ATM sales in H1 2026.
News explaining the +20% five-day move: none found beyond the date notice and the CTAD poster release.
Peer anti-amyloid / oligomer readouts in October 2026: none found.
Investor day (2026-09-16) content beyond slide text: no post-event coverage found.

rejected_candidates.candidate: The CTAD 2026-10-22 release names only baseline posters, which could imply no topline before mid-November.
rejected_candidates.detail: Merged into the timing finding (finding 1) as corroboration; late-breaker slots are not public, so it carries no separate size.
Opex is expected to fall with trial wind-down (Q2 R&D $27.8m against $37.1m a year earlier). This is already in the cash walk of finding 2, and EPS is not the line this pre-revenue name trades on.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. My slight negative lean cuts against the +20% five-day run-up only in arguing that the run-up fades, and with roughly 4% of float short there is no squeeze mechanism to fear.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction; 5 of 7 prior prints down/flat): timing-confirmation finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3.
Lesson 5 (positioning and unexplained moves in microcaps are worth near 0, proxies filed small): run-up fade finding cut from -1.0 to -0.5.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the cash finding is kept at -0.5, because the money funds no corroborated ramp and the going-concern flag stands.
Lesson 6 (single-source bar): every size was already small. abs_move_pct and p_up are unchanged.
